grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, eggs, honey, yoghurt, ground almonds, bicarb, strawberries and lemon are all plain home staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item is on Tesco shelves; the 250g of ground almonds is the priciest part but still an everyday baking ingredient.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a loaf tin, small pan, bowl, whisk and a skewer, with simple whisk-and-fold technique.

works.reason: Four eggs, 250g ground almonds, yoghurt and bicarb give a sound gluten-free batter that bakes through in 50 minutes at 180°C and slices for four with yoghurt.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers lining the tin, melting butter, zesting, hulling and chopping strawberries and almonds, and the 50-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item appears in the steps, including lemon as zest and natural yoghurt for serving, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Late-May strawberries run through and top the loaf, so they are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, almonds and yoghurt give real protein, and only 3 tbsp honey sweetens the loaf, so it is a filling, wholesome breakfast.
